## 1. Packages

```{r, eval=FALSE}
# installer les packages (une seule fois)
install.packages(c("xts", "zoo", "tseries", "forecast", "jsonlite"))
```

## 2. Chargement des données

```{r}
library(xts)        # séries temporelles
library(zoo)        # fenêtres glissantes, na.locf
library(tseries)    # ADF, KPSS, Jarque-Bera
library(forecast)   # ARIMA, auto.arima
library(jsonlite)   # lire split.json
set.seed(42)        # reproductibilité

# même csv que Python
raw <- read.csv("data/btc_eth.csv")
raw$date <- as.Date(raw$date)
x <- xts(raw[, c("btc_close", "eth_close", "btc_volume", "eth_volume")], order.by = raw$date)

cat("Période :", format(start(x)), "->", format(end(x)), "\n")
cat("Nb lignes :", nrow(x), "\n")
head(x)
```

## 3. Nettoyage, variables dérivées et split

```{r}
# une ligne par jour (crypto = 7 j / 7)
jours <- seq(start(x), end(x), by = "day")
cat("Jours manquants :", length(setdiff(jours, index(x))), "\n")
cat("Doublons :", sum(duplicated(index(x))), "\n")
cat("NaN :", sum(is.na(x)), "\n")

x <- merge(x, xts(, jours))     # ajoute les jours manquants (NaN)
x <- na.locf(x)                 # remplit avec la dernière valeur connue

# variables dérivées
for (a in c("btc", "eth")) {
  lp <- log(x[, paste0(a, "_close")])                                       # log-prix
  x  <- merge(x, setNames(lp, paste0(a, "_logp")))
  x  <- merge(x, setNames(diff(lp), paste0(a, "_ret")))                     # log-rendement
  x  <- merge(x, setNames(rollmeanr(x[, paste0(a, "_close")], 50, fill = NA), paste0(a, "_ma50")))
  x  <- merge(x, setNames(rollmeanr(x[, paste0(a, "_close")], 200, fill = NA), paste0(a, "_ma200")))
  x  <- merge(x, setNames(rollapplyr(x[, paste0(a, "_ret")], 30, sd, fill = NA) * sqrt(365),
                          paste0(a, "_vol30")))                             # volatilité 30 j annualisée
}

# même split que Python
split <- fromJSON("data/split.json")
train_end  <- as.Date(split$train_end)
test_start <- as.Date(split$test_start)
cat("Train jusqu'au", split$train_end, "| test à partir du", split$test_start, "\n")

tail(x[, c("btc_close", "btc_logp", "btc_ret", "btc_vol30")])
```

## 4. Graphiques

```{r, fig.width=10, fig.height=7}
events <- as.Date(c("2020-03-12", "2022-05-09", "2022-11-08", "2024-01-10"))   # COVID, Luna, FTX, ETF

# prix + moyennes mobiles (échelle log)
par(mfrow = c(2, 1), mar = c(3, 4, 2, 1))
for (a in c("btc", "eth")) {
  plot(index(x), as.numeric(x[, paste0(a, "_close")]), type = "l", log = "y",
       xlab = "", ylab = paste(toupper(a), "(USD, log)"), main = paste(toupper(a), "- prix et moyennes mobiles"))
  lines(index(x), as.numeric(x[, paste0(a, "_ma50")]), col = "orange")
  lines(index(x), as.numeric(x[, paste0(a, "_ma200")]), col = "darkgreen")
  abline(v = events, lty = 2, col = "grey")
  legend("topleft", c("Clôture", "MA 50", "MA 200"), col = c("black", "orange", "darkgreen"), lty = 1, cex = 0.7)
}
```

```{r, fig.width=10, fig.height=7}
# rendements BTC + volatilité 30 j
par(mfrow = c(2, 1), mar = c(3, 4, 2, 1))
plot(index(x), as.numeric(x$btc_ret), type = "l", xlab = "", ylab = "Log-rendement BTC")
abline(v = events, lty = 2, col = "grey")

plot(index(x), as.numeric(x$eth_vol30), type = "l", col = "orange", xlab = "",
     ylab = "Volatilité 30 j (annualisée)")
lines(index(x), as.numeric(x$btc_vol30), col = "steelblue")
legend("topright", c("ETH", "BTC"), col = c("orange", "steelblue"), lty = 1, cex = 0.7)
```
## 5. Statistiques descriptives

```{r}
desc <- do.call(rbind, lapply(c("btc", "eth"), function(a) {
  r <- na.omit(as.numeric(x[, paste0(a, "_ret")]))
  m <- mean(r); s <- sd(r)
  jb <- jarque.bera.test(r)                                   # test de normalité
  data.frame(actif = toupper(a), n = length(r), moyenne = m, ecart_type = s,
             min = min(r), max = max(r),
             skewness = mean((r - m)^3) / s^3,                # asymétrie
             kurtosis = mean((r - m)^4) / s^4 - 3,            # excès de kurtosis
             JB_pvalue = jb$p.value)
}))
dir.create("results/tables", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
write.csv(desc, "results/tables/01_stats_descriptives_R.csv", row.names = FALSE)
cat("Corrélation BTC/ETH :", round(cor(x$btc_ret, x$eth_ret, use = "complete.obs"), 3), "\n")
print(desc, digits = 4)
```

## 6. Outliers (IQR glissant 90 j)

```{r}
outl <- do.call(rbind, lapply(c("btc", "eth"), function(a) {
  r  <- x[, paste0(a, "_ret")]
  q1 <- rollapplyr(r, 90, quantile, probs = 0.25, na.rm = TRUE, fill = NA)
  q3 <- rollapplyr(r, 90, quantile, probs = 0.75, na.rm = TRUE, fill = NA)
  iqr <- q3 - q1
  i <- which(as.numeric(r) < as.numeric(q1 - 3 * iqr) | as.numeric(r) > as.numeric(q3 + 3 * iqr))
  data.frame(actif = toupper(a), date = index(r)[i], rendement = round(as.numeric(r[i]), 4))
}))
write.csv(outl, "results/tables/01_outliers_R.csv", row.names = FALSE)
table(outl$actif)                                  # nombre par actif
head(outl[order(outl$rendement), ], 10)            # les 10 pires chocs
```

## 7. ACF / PACF

```{r, fig.width=10, fig.height=8}
for (a in c("btc", "eth")) {
  lp <- na.omit(as.numeric(x[, paste0(a, "_logp")]))
  r  <- na.omit(as.numeric(x[, paste0(a, "_ret")]))
  par(mfrow = c(3, 2), mar = c(4, 4, 3, 1))
  acf(lp, 40, main = paste(toupper(a), "ACF log-prix"));      pacf(lp, 40, main = "PACF log-prix")
  acf(r, 40, main = "ACF rendements");                        pacf(r, 40, main = "PACF rendements")
  acf(r^2, 40, main = "ACF rendements au carré");             pacf(r^2, 40, main = "PACF rendements au carré")
}
```

## 8. Décomposition STL

```{r, fig.width=10, fig.height=7}
for (a in c("btc", "eth")) for (per in c(7, 365)) {
  lp  <- ts(as.numeric(x[, paste0(a, "_logp")]), frequency = per)
  fit <- stl(lp, s.window = "periodic", robust = TRUE)
  sea <- fit$time.series[, "seasonal"]; rem <- fit$time.series[, "remainder"]
  cat(toupper(a), "période", per, ": force saisonnalité =",
      round(max(0, 1 - var(rem) / var(sea + rem)), 3), "\n")
  plot(fit, main = paste("STL", toupper(a), "- période", per))
}
```

## 9. Stationnarité : ADF et KPSS

```{r}
statio <- do.call(rbind, lapply(c("btc", "eth"), function(a) {
  do.call(rbind, lapply(c("logp", "ret"), function(v) {
    s   <- na.omit(as.numeric(x[, paste0(a, "_", v)]))
    adf <- suppressWarnings(adf.test(s))                                         # H0 : racine unitaire
    kp  <- suppressWarnings(kpss.test(s, null = if (v == "logp") "Trend" else "Level"))  # H0 : stationnaire
    data.frame(actif = toupper(a), serie = ifelse(v == "logp", "log-prix", "log-rendement"),
               ADF_p = round(adf$p.value, 4), KPSS_p = round(kp$p.value, 4),
               conclusion = ifelse(adf$p.value < 0.05 & kp$p.value > 0.05, "stationnaire", "non stationnaire"))
  }))
}))
write.csv(statio, "results/tables/01_stationnarite_R.csv", row.names = FALSE)
statio
```
